worked_solution:
Substituting $x=\frac{\pi }{3}$ directly into the limit, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \pi /3}\operatorname{csc}⁡(2x) & =\operatorname{csc}⁡(2\cdot \frac{\pi }{3}) \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{2\pi }{3})} \\  & =\frac{1}{(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})} \\  & =\frac{2\sqrt{3}}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
